findings.conclusion: detach is a last-resort same-set all-reserved Tag relief, not any cache miss, HIT_RESERVED, high Tag occupancy or positive RO certificate. RO candidate new-request preview can rewrite raw FAIL to MISS, so the actual supported production path is reachable.
findings.proof: Existing PRESSURE_ELIGIBLE uses f.send/await_lower with16 real same-set pending RO lines and a17th request, observes actual Tag detach and later retirement. E reviewed frame detach_success2/detached_retired2; no new test was run.

findings.conclusion: An ordinary non-RO native read with no TVD special route and raw all-reserved FAIL gets RO.preview=false; baseline preview returns FAIL without detachable check. line_available=false blocks the frontend, so ft_access/relieve is not consulted even if same-set RO victim is eligible. It lasts while that pressure state persists, not a demonstrated permanent application deadlock.
findings.lineage: Inherited from main61 d010, not introduced by observer9243. new_request/native_owner_conflict/detachable/probe/can_detach blocks are byte-identical where reported.

findings.conclusion: For a different-address replacement, any RESERVED sector makes sector_cache_block::is_reserved_line true, so a mixed VALID/RESERVED way is not selected as an ordinary replacement. An all-ready but still response-pinned way can be chosen as Tag MISS and then correctly denied by FT pin/pending protection. This is not Tag-all-reserved FAIL; it is a payload-lifetime guard. The detach predicate rejects all-ready victims.
findings.additional_scope: If a MISS-selected pinned-ready victim blocks replacement while another way is detachable pending RO, current policy still does not call relieve because raw probe was MISS. This is an opportunity/trigger-policy boundary, not proof of unsafe reclamation or an observed application failure.
findings.actual_limit: Root actual denied_pin0 for the three accepted new endpoints means no evidence this path caused those outcomes.

findings.conclusion: HIT_RESERVED is a matching requested sector already RESERVED and is returned inside the Tag-match loop before the all_reserved decision. It needs one matching Tag, not16 reserved ways. DWT raw_hit_reserved7250 reported by root does not establish Tag-set pressure or7250 distinct successful merges. Frontend counters are head-physical-cycle observations; successful RO merge counters have a different denominator.

Victim is selected by first eligible Tag index in requester same set. It must reference a live RO transaction, T enabled, attached, reuse_seen=false and required&~ready nonzero. reuse_seen becomes sticky on an accepted merge and is not cleared merely because a waiter retires; returning payload/Tag generation identity must match.
findings.guard: No claim that certified input or positive transaction count alone implies eligible pressure or expected nonzero detach.

findings.conclusion: Actual detach changes Tag/payload identity then increments tx.stats.detached and diagnostic_success in the same function. Observer is registered before RO transaction construction, and ro_print checks diagnostic.detach_success equals authoritative legacy detached per slice. Global/64slice/phase closure and matching selector are guarded. No counter reset or enabled-observer initialization gap was found in this review.
